decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the rear extension  and roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The single-storey rear extension hereby permitted shall only be used ancillary to the ground floor retail use of the premises known as 206 Great West Road.
description: Demolition of existing store and outbuildings and the erection of single storey rear extension to the existing shop, erection of roof extension with two rooflights to front elevation and erection of an external rear staircase to existing first floor flat
